rules: Do not infer software execution from tests of synthetic reference code
Zero independent task admission until external human/runner/oracle evidence exists
No paid GPU without approved rights/security gates and measured pilot duration
No unverified live Overleaf synchronization or PDF compile claims
Do not include hidden evaluation labels or post-fix patches in agent prompts
No fabricated human reviewer signatures or external experiments
Respect separate CALM-SE and OpenCoderX-E research overlap boundaries
Source-only PR metadata does not equal 120 runnable repos or 12 confirmed changed languages
